type: ReplayEvent { id, raceId, frameIndex, eventTimeS, leaderLap, kind, label, driverId }

taxonomy.RC_MESSAGE: (last_message_category,last_message_flag) pair change with non-null category; label joins source parts verbatim
taxonomy.PIT: pit_stops_completed_so_far increment from known count; label PIT STOP · DRIVER · n
taxonomy.LAP: leader_lap increment; first frame of the lap

omitted.RETIREMENT: no causal signal in frontend frame data; backend performs no retirement inference; backdating from final classification forbidden

rules.mapping: first canonical frame at which the change is observable; never nearest
rules.ordering: (frameIndex, FLAG, MESSAGE, PIT driver-sorted, LAP); deterministic across reloads
